summary: Answered operator's question about whether review claiming is atomic by inspecting live main source. ReviewWorkflow.claimBranchReview binds exact expected review version, checks Unclaimed, and commits Claimed/reviewer/version+1 via LedgerStore.transact. LedgerStore.transact fetches verified canonical ledger, plans against that snapshot, writes a single Git tree and updates remote ledger ref with non-force push; on contention refetches and replans, so only one simultaneous claim wins, loser returns ReviewAlreadyClaimed. Same operation ID is idempotent via recorded operation hash. Searched tests: review claim/release and claimed replacement guard exist, but no dedicated simultaneous claim race regression identified. No code, task, review or deployment changes; observation only.
nextAction: Operator: no immediate action required.
